title: mrr.changed payload v1
description: A subscription's monthly recurring revenue (MRR) as the books hold it, after the Stripe fact that moved it: a USD invoice that billed its recurring lines in full (create or cycle), a customer.subscription.* event whose items changed, or the subscription's end. Each item is a recurring price on the subscription: its amount less its discount, over the months of its interval, rounded half up to whole cents a month. One-time lines are not items. The postings move `mrr:recurring:<holder>` by after - before in the MRR commodity (whole cents), against `mrr:movement:<movement>`.

from.description: What moved it: a paid invoice (`invoice` names it), a customer.subscription.* event whose items changed, or the subscription's end.

before.description: MRR before, whole cents a month (0 for a subscription first seen).

after.description: MRR after, whole cents a month: the sum of the items' cents (0 once the subscription ended).

months.description: Months of one period: 1 a month, 12 a year, times the price's interval count.

amount.description: What a full period of the item costs: the invoice line's amount, or unit_amount x quantity from the subscription event (cents).

discount.description: What discounts take off that amount (cents): the line's discount_amounts, or the same share of a changed item as the last full invoice gave.

cents.description: (amount - discount) / months, rounded half up: what the item adds a month.

ended.description: The subscription ended (customer.subscription.deleted, or status canceled): after is 0.
